title: Ed4All concept_coverage.json
description: Top-level concept-keyed coverage table. Concept-graph analogue of coverage_map.json: for every DomainConcept node, tallies which pedagogical SURFACES touch it (explained / defined-in-glossary / assessed / demonstrated / prereq-scaffolded). Built by lib/aggregators/concept_coverage.py::ConceptCoverageAggregator post-workflow and emitted at <libv2_course>/concept_coverage.json. Gated by ED4ALL_CONCEPT_COVERAGE (default OFF => no file). Worker W4.1.

course_code.description: Operator-facing course code so cross-run diffs key cleanly.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the build call.

concepts.description: Per-concept coverage rows, sorted by concept_id.

concept_id.description: Concept-graph node id (canonical slug, or {course_id}:{slug} when scoped).

label.description: Human-readable concept label (node.label, falls back to concept_id).

explained.description: True when the concept is touched by a defined-by edge (defined_by_from_first_mention) OR carries any occurrence chunk (content prose mentions it).

defined_in_glossary.description: True when the concept is touched by an is-a edge (is_a_from_key_terms — the key-terms/glossary definition rule).

assessed.description: True when the concept is touched by a targets-concept edge (a learning objective explicitly targets the concept at a Bloom level).

demonstrated.description: True when the concept is touched by an exemplifies edge (an example / worked-example chunk exemplifies the concept).

prereq_scaffolded.description: True when the concept is an endpoint of a prerequisite edge in the concept graph (concept-level prerequisite scaffolding). Course-level content-derived prerequisite edges (W3.1 prerequisite_from_definition_mention) are additionally surfaced in summary.content_derived_prereq_edges.

surface_count.description: Count of the five surfaces that touch this concept.

touching_chunks.description: Chunk ids that reference this concept (node.occurrences[]), sorted.

fully_covered_concepts.description: Concept ids touched by all five surfaces.

uncovered_concepts.description: Concept ids touched by zero surfaces (a node the corpus mints but never explains/defines/assesses/demonstrates/scaffolds).

content_derived_prereq_edges.description: Count of prerequisite edges whose provenance.rule is the W3.1 content-derived rule (prerequisite_from_definition_mention). A course-level richness signal for the prereq-scaffolded axis.

surface_count_histogram.description: Map of surface-count (0..5, string keys) -> number of concepts with that many touching surfaces.
